confidence_notes: Medium overall. Restaurant, cafe and beer anchors rest on several aggregated sources, but they are dated (Numbeo-derived figures from November 2025) and beer sources differ widely. Dinar conversions use roughly 100-105 RSD per USD. Cocktail is one club price from a source that flags it as unreliable, cross-checked against the beer price. Wine_glass has no direct source and is set at about 1.3x beer. Accommodation is least certain: hostel and hotel snapshots vary two to three times, many are undated or show 'from' rates, and July values are judgement. The 1-star anchor is inferred from budget double-room snippets rather than a verified average. FX 0.6955 comes from RBA exchange-rate excerpts returned by search, not a direct table read.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Anchors are Belgrade-specific: restaurant and bar figures from aggregated sources (Numbeo-derived figures republished by Expat.com, MyLifeElsewhere, getwherenext, Expatistan) and hostel and hotel listing snapshots (Budgetyourtrip, Hostelz, KAYAK, Skyscanner, Trabber, Trip.com), set to July peak-season levels.
